reviews.review:
Very complex game with many different ways to play. The modding community is quite large and is very active in developing new and interesting games types. The controls are hard to get a hang of but once you understand them the game is very intuitive. The netcode is not the best so there is a very real desync problem in large servers but the experiences you have far out weigh the negatives of this game. 

I highly recommend this to anyone who is looking for a game to play with friends and enjoys a challenge as well as a hardcore gaming mindset.

The large downsides to the game are the prices of DLC and its requirement to fully enjoy the game, the desync (or rubber banding) while playing in some scenarios, and the UI/control scheme that is very hard to understand and use intuitively.
war war never changes arma 3 is a great game mostly with lots of mods and better with friends

Definitely can not recommend this. 

Very awkward controls, such as needing a different key to enter a vehicle as to exit one, very non-intuitive map making it clumsy to find yourself (you press the key to do so and it zooms to a different, forced and predetermined level and still doesn't actually mark yourself on the map) and designate markers, weak environment renderings that are OK but nothing compared to similar first person shooters that have been out for quite a while. The weapons you start with are a poor choice for the combat environment there is no simple way change them unless you shoot someone and take their's.

The game itself is only an intro and one mission as most of the game is a bunch of DLCs that you have to buy, which you only find out after and I was definitely not going to go down that rabbit hole.

Was only interested in the campaigns and after about 10 hours I can't bear the pain anymore so I'm uninstalling it.
Get it because it's a good game
